title: Remove duplicate release note explaining 1.34.0 non-publication
context: CHANGELOG.md contained two adjacent explanations of why version 1.34.0 was tagged but never published—one concise, one detailed. Both conveyed identical core information. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job, done without waiting for the human: accept shipped roadmap proposals, settle provenance-repair escalations (apply the true commit or drop), re-anchor or stale findings, and land the resulting capture commits through a PR. Only decisions that need genuine product judgment are queued for the human.).
decision: Deleted the longer, more specific explanation (which included deployment-approval context) in favor of the existing brief statement that 1.34.0 was 'superseded before npm publication.'
consequences: Reduced verbosity in changelog; scannability improved
Lost specificity about *why* 1.34.0 failed to publish (deployment approval denied)
alternatives_rejected: Retain both notes for comprehensive historical context
Merge both into a single note that combines conciseness with detail
